en.s: The Battle of Fiorenzuola was fought on 29 July 923 between the forces of Rudolph II of Burgundy and Adalbert I of Ivrea on one side and Berengar I of Italy on the other. The battle was a defeat for Berengar, who was thus de facto dethroned and replaced by Rudolf as King of Italy.

zh.s: 菲奥伦佐拉战役于923年7月29日爆发。一方是勃艮第国王鲁道夫二世与伊夫雷亚的阿达尔贝托一世，另一方是意大利国王贝伦加尔一世。贝伦加尔战败，事实上被废黜，鲁道夫取代他成为意大利国王。

en.s: The Battle of Cervera took place near Espinosa de Cervera on 29 July 1000 between the Christian troops of counts Sancho García of Castile and García Gómez of Saldaña and the Muslim Caliphate of Córdoba under the hajib Almanzor. The battle, "tremendous and difficult to describe", was a victory for Almanzor. The battle is listed as the fifty-second of Almanzor's career in the Dikr bilad al-Andalus.

zh.s: 塞尔韦拉战役于1000年7月29日在埃斯皮诺萨-德塞尔韦拉附近爆发，交战双方是卡斯蒂利亚伯爵桑乔·加西亚和萨尔达尼亚伯爵加西亚·戈麦斯率领的基督教军队，以及科尔多瓦哈里发国的穆斯林军队。后者由宫廷总管阿尔曼苏尔统率。战役以阿尔曼苏尔获胜告终，战况“惨烈得难以描述”。《安达卢斯地区记述》将此战列为阿尔曼苏尔军事生涯中的第52场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Kleidion (or Clidium, after the medieval name of the village of Klyuch, "(the) key"; also known as the Battle of Belasitsa) took place on July 29, 1014 between the Byzantine Empire and the Bulgarian Empire. It was the culmination of the nearly half-century struggle between the Byzantine Emperor Basil II and the Bulgarian Emperor Samuil in the late 10th and early 11th centuries. The result was a decisive Byzantine victory. The battle took place in the valley between the mountains of Belasitsa and Ograzhden near the modern Bulgarian village of Klyuch.

zh.s: 克莱迪翁战役（又称克利迪乌姆战役，得名于村庄克柳奇的中世纪名称，意为“钥匙”；也称贝拉西察战役）于1014年7月29日在拜占庭帝国与保加利亚帝国之间爆发。这场战役是拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世与保加利亚皇帝萨穆伊尔在10世纪末至11世纪初近半个世纪冲突的高潮。拜占庭取得决定性胜利。战场位于贝拉西察山和奥格拉日登山之间的山谷，靠近今保加利亚村庄克柳奇。

en.s: The Battle of Vlaardingen was fought on 29 July 1018. The Holy Roman emperor sent an army towards Holland to subdue the rebellious Count Dirk III. However, the imperial army was decisively defeated and fled in panic. Knowledge of the battle is based on three chronicles, written shortly after the date: De diversitate temporum by the monk Alpertus of Metz, the Chronicon of Thietmar, bishop of Merseburg, and in the Cambrai Bishop’s Chronicle. Also, recent archaeological discoveries shed some light on Vlaardingen in the 11th century.

zh.s: 弗拉尔丁根战役于1018年7月29日爆发。神圣罗马帝国皇帝派遣军队前往荷兰，镇压叛乱伯爵迪尔克三世。但帝国军队遭到决定性失败，仓皇逃走。关于这场战役的记载来自三部事发不久后撰写的编年史：梅斯修士阿尔贝图斯的《时代差异》、梅泽堡主教蒂特马尔的《编年史》，以及《康布雷主教编年史》。近年来的考古发现也为了解11世纪的弗拉尔丁根提供了一些线索。

en.s: The Battle of Stiklestad (Norwegian: Slaget på Stiklestad; Old Norse: Stiklastaðaorrusta) in 1030 is one of the most famous battles in the history of Norway. In this battle, King Olaf II of Norway was killed. During the pontificate of Pope Alexander III, the Roman Catholic Church declared Olaf a saint in 1164. His younger half-brother, Harald Hardrada, was also present at the battle.
en.n: Ladejarl-Fairhair succession wars: Battle of Stiklestad: King Olaf II fights and dies trying to regain his Norwegian throne from the Danes.

zh.s: 斯蒂克莱斯塔德战役（挪威语：Slaget på Stiklestad；古诺尔斯语：Stiklastaðaorrusta）发生于1030年，是挪威历史上最著名的战役之一。挪威国王奥拉夫二世在战斗中阵亡。亚历山大三世任教宗期间，罗马天主教会于1164年封奥拉夫为圣人。他同父异母的弟弟哈拉尔·哈德拉达也参加了这场战役。
zh.n: 拉德伯爵与金发王朝的王位继承战争：斯蒂克莱斯塔德战役：挪威国王奥拉夫二世在试图从丹麦人手中夺回王位时阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Espichel took place on 29 July 1180 between naval squadrons of Portugal and the Almohad Caliphate. The battle occurred at Cape Espichel on the Atlantic coast of Portugal and is considered to be the first naval battle in Portuguese history. The Portuguese defeated the Almohads, killing their admiral in the process and capturing several advanced Mediterranean galleys intact.

zh.s: 埃斯皮谢尔角海战于1180年7月29日在葡萄牙和阿尔摩哈德哈里发国的舰队之间爆发，地点位于葡萄牙大西洋海岸的埃斯皮谢尔角。这被认为是葡萄牙历史上的第一场海战。葡萄牙人击败阿尔摩哈德人，并杀死其海军将领，还缴获数艘完好的先进地中海桨帆船。

en.s: The siege of Neuss, from 1474–75, was linked to the Cologne Diocesan Feud and part of the Burgundian Wars. The siege, led by Charles the Bold against the Imperial City of Neuss, was unsuccessful. Charles was compelled by the approach of a powerful Imperial army to raise the siege.

en.s: The Battle of Melrose (also known as the Battle of Darnick) was a Scottish clan battle that took place on 29 July 1526. Walter Scott of Branxholme and Buccleuch attempted to rescue the young James V of Scotland from the powerful Archibald Douglas, 6th Earl of Angus.

zh.s: 梅尔罗斯战役（又称达尼克战役）是苏格兰氏族之间的一场战斗，于1526年7月29日发生。布兰克斯霍姆和巴克卢的沃尔特·斯科特试图从势力强大的第六代安格斯伯爵阿奇博尔德·道格拉斯手中救出年轻的苏格兰国王詹姆斯五世。

en.s: The Count's Feud (Danish: Grevens Fejde), sometimes referred to as the Count's War, was a Danish war of succession occurring from 1534 to 1536, which gave rise to the Reformation in Denmark. In the broader international context, it was a part of the European wars of religion.

en.s: James VI (1566–1625), son of Mary, Queen of Scots (1542–1587) and Lord Darnley (1546–1567), was crowned King of Scotland by Adam Bothwell, Bishop of Orkney, in the Holy Rude Kirk at Stirling on 29 July 1567. The king was just over one year old.

zh.s: 詹姆斯六世（1566–1625）是苏格兰女王玛丽（1542–1587）和达恩利勋爵（1546–1567）之子。1567年7月29日，他在斯特灵的圣鲁德教堂由奥克尼主教亚当·博思韦尔加冕为苏格兰国王。加冕时，他刚满一岁。

en.s: The Battle of Hel was a naval raid took place on July 29, 1571, when a squadron of the Royal Dano-Norwegian Navy raided the Baltic Sea ports of Puck and Hel, destroying or capturing fifteen ships of the privateer fleet (Polish: Flota kaperska) and Polish and Lithuanian troops of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, and taking those that were captured back to the city of Copenhagen.

zh.s: 赫尔海战是一次海上突袭，发生于1571年7月29日。丹麦-挪威皇家海军的一支舰队袭击波罗的海港口普克和赫尔，摧毁或俘获了15艘波兰私掠船队舰船，以及波兰立陶宛联邦的波兰和立陶宛军队。丹麦-挪威方面将俘获的舰船带回哥本哈根。

en.s: The Long Turkish War, or Thirteen Years' War, was an indecisive land war between the Holy Roman Empire (primarily the Habsburg monarchy) and the Ottoman Empire, primarily over the principalities of Wallachia, Transylvania, and Moldavia. It was waged from 1593 to 1606, but in Europe, especially in Hungary, it is called the Fifteen Years' War (Hungarian: tizenöt éves háború), reckoning from the 1591–1592 Turkish campaign that captured Bihać in the Kingdom of Croatia.

zh.s: 土耳其长期战争又称十三年战争，是神圣罗马帝国（主要为哈布斯堡君主国）与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场胶着陆战，争夺重点是瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔达维亚诸公国。战争从1593年持续到1606年；在欧洲，尤其是匈牙利，这场战争称为“十五年战争”（匈牙利语：tizenöt éves háború），其起算点是1591至1592年土耳其战役攻占克罗地亚王国的比哈奇。

en.s: The Battle of Landen (or Neerwinden), in the current Belgian province of Flemish Brabant, was a battle in the Nine Years' War, fought in present-day Belgium on 29 July 1693 between the French army of Marshal Luxembourg and the Allied army of King William III of England. The French assaulted the Allied position three times before the French cavalry finally penetrated the allied defences and drove William's army from the field in a rout. The battle was, however, quite costly for both sides, the French losing 9,000 men to the Allies' 19,000. The French failed to follow up on their victory, allowing William to escape.

zh.s: 兰登战役（又称尼尔温登战役）于1693年7月29日在今比利时弗拉芒布拉班特省发生，是九年战争的一场战斗。交战双方是卢森堡元帅指挥的法国军队和英格兰国王威廉三世率领的盟军。法军三次进攻盟军阵地后，骑兵最终突破防线，击溃威廉的军队。不过双方损失惨重：法军损失9,000人，盟军损失19,000人。法军没有乘胜追击，使威廉得以逃脱。

en.s: The action of 29 July 1782 took place during the end of the American War of Independence. The Royal Navy frigate HMS Santa Margarita captured the French Navy frigate French frigate Amazone off Cape Henry, but on the next day a French squadron under Louis-Philippe de Vaudreuil intervened and recaptured Amazone.

zh.s: 这场海战发生在美国独立战争末期。英国皇家海军“圣玛格丽塔”号护卫舰于1782年7月29日在亨利角附近俘获法国海军“亚马逊”号护卫舰。次日，路易-菲利普·德·沃德勒伊率领的法国舰队赶到，并重新夺回“亚马逊”号。

en.s: Battle of Saločiai (Lithuanian: Saločių kautynės, Russian: Бой под Салатами, Polish: Bitwa pod Sałatami) was a battle fought during the Kościuszko Uprising on July 29, 1794, between the troops of Grand Duchy of Lithuania under the command of General Prince Romuald Giedroyć and the Russian troops of Prince Sergei Fedorovich Golitsyn.

zh.s: 萨洛恰伊战役（立陶宛语：Saločių kautynės；俄语：Бой под Салатами；波兰语：Bitwa pod Sałatami）是科希丘什科起义期间的一场战斗，于1794年7月29日爆发。交战双方是罗穆阿尔德·盖德罗伊奇将军统率的立陶宛大公国军队，以及谢尔盖·费奥多罗维奇·戈利岑亲王率领的俄军。

en.s: The Battle of Évora (29 July 1808) saw an Imperial French division under Louis Henri Loison attack a combined Portuguese-Spanish force led by Francisco de Paula Leite de Sousa. Encountering Leite's smaller body of soldiers outside Évora, the French easily brushed them aside and went on to storm the city, which was held by poorly armed townsmen and militia. The French butchered the Portuguese defenders and brutally sacked the town. The hated Loison was known among the Portuguese as the Maneta (One-Hand), because of his amputated arm.

zh.s: 1808年7月29日，路易·亨利·卢瓦松率领的法兰西帝国军一个师进攻弗朗西斯科·德·保拉·莱特·德·索萨率领的葡萄牙与西班牙联军。法军在埃武拉城外遇到人数较少的莱特部队，轻易将其击退，随后攻入由装备简陋的市民和民兵守卫的城镇。法军屠杀了葡萄牙守军，并残暴地洗劫城镇。卢瓦松是葡萄牙人憎恨的将领，因失去一条手臂而被称为“独臂人”。

en.s: The invasion of Hvaler (Swedish: Invasionen av Hvaleröarna) was a Swedish military invasion during the Swedish-Norwegian War of 1814. The invasion was directed at the Norwegian archipelago of Hvaler in the southwestern part of Østfold, Norway. The invasion went off rather peacefully. The hostilities opened on 26 July with a swift Swedish naval attack against the Norwegian gunboats at Hvaler.

zh.s: 哈瓦尔群岛入侵（瑞典语：Invasionen av Hvaleröarna）是1814年瑞典—挪威战争期间瑞典对挪威发动的一次军事入侵，目标是挪威东福尔郡西南部的哈瓦尔群岛。入侵过程相对平静。敌对行动于7月26日开始，瑞典海军迅速袭击了哈瓦尔群岛的挪威炮艇。

en.s: The July Revolution (French: Révolution de Juillet), also known as the French Revolution of 1830, Second French Revolution, or les Trois Glorieuses ("the Three Glorious [Days]"), was a second French Revolution after the first of 1789–99. It led to the overthrow of King Charles X, the French Bourbon monarch, and the ascent of his cousin Louis Philippe, Duke of Orléans, who governed for 18 years as the last king of France.

zh.s: 七月革命（法语：Révolution de Juillet）又称1830年法国革命、第二次法国革命或“三个光荣日”（les Trois Glorieuses），是继1789年至1799年法国大革命之后的第二次法国革命。革命推翻了法国波旁王朝国王查理十世，由他的堂弟奥尔良公爵路易-菲利普继位。路易-菲利普统治18年，成为法国最后一位国王。

en.s: The Battle of Beilan (Turkish:Belen) is an engagement fought by the Egyptian army led by Ibrahim Pasha against the Ottoman army led by Hussein Pasha on July 29, 1832, during the Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833). This battle lasted for 3 hours, the Ottoman army was defeated in a crushing defeat and Ibrahim Pasha captured Belen.

zh.s: 贝兰战役（土耳其语：Belen）是埃及—奥斯曼战争（1831–1833）期间的一场战斗，于1832年7月29日爆发。易卜拉欣帕夏率领埃及军队与侯赛因帕夏率领的奥斯曼军队交战。战斗持续3小时，奥斯曼军队惨败，易卜拉欣帕夏攻占贝兰。

en.s: The Young Irelander Rebellion was a failed Irish nationalist uprising led by the Young Ireland movement, part of the wider Revolutions of 1848 that affected most of Europe. It took place on 29 July 1848 in the village of Ballingarry, South Tipperary. After being chased by a force of Young Irelanders and their supporters, an Irish Constabulary unit raided a house and took those inside as hostages. A several-hour gunfight followed, but the rebels fled after a large group of police reinforcements arrived. It is sometimes called the Famine Rebellion (since it took place during the Great Irish Famine) or the Battle of Ballingarry.

zh.s: 青年爱尔兰运动领导的民族主义起义于1848年7月29日在南蒂珀雷里郡巴林加里村爆发，但最终失败。这场起义是席卷欧洲大部分地区的1848年革命的一部分。当青年爱尔兰人及其支持者追赶一支爱尔兰警察部队后，警察突袭一所房屋并扣押屋内人员作为人质。双方随后交火数小时；大批增援警察抵达后，起义者撤退。这场起义也称“饥荒起义”（因发生在爱尔兰大饥荒期间）或“巴林加里战役”。

en.t: Treaty of Amity and Commerce (United States–Japan)
en.s: The Treaty of Amity and Commerce between Japan and the United States (日米修好通商条約, Nichibei Shūkō Tsūshō Jōyaku), also called the Harris Treaty was a treaty signed between the United States and Tokugawa Shogunate, which opened the ports of Kanagawa and four other Japanese cities to trade and granted extraterritoriality to foreigners, among a number of trading stipulations. It was signed on the deck of the USS Powhatan in Edo (now Tokyo) Bay on July 29, 1858.

zh.s: 《美日修好通商条约》（日语：日米修好通商条約）又称《哈里斯条约》，由美国与德川幕府签署。条约包含多项贸易条款，开放神奈川和日本另外四座城市的港口进行贸易，并赋予外国人治外法权。条约于1858年7月29日在江户（今东京）湾的“波瓦坦”号军舰甲板上签署。

en.s: The Revolution of the Park (Revolución del Parque), also known as the Revolution of 1890 or Revolution of '90, was a civic-military uprising against the national government of Argentina that took place from July 26 to 29, 1890. The revolution began with the takeover of the Buenos Aires Artillery Park (Parque de Artillería), located in what is today Lavalle Square.

en.s: The Battle of Seonghwan (成歓の戦い) was the first major land battle of the First Sino-Japanese War. It took place on 29 July 1894 at the hamlet of Seonghwan, outside of Cheonan, Chungcheongnam-do Korea between the forces of Meiji Japan and Qing China. It is also referred to as the Battle of Asan (Japanese: 牙山作戦 ).

en.s: Umberto I (Italian: Umberto Ranieri Carlo Emanuele Giovanni Maria Ferdinando Eugenio di Savoia; 14 March 1844 – 29 July 1900) was King of Italy from 9 January 1878 until his assassination in 1900. zh.t: 意大利国王翁贝托一世遇刺身亡，其子维托里奥·埃马努埃莱三世继位
zh.s: 翁贝托一世全名翁贝托·拉涅利·卡洛·埃马努埃莱·乔瓦尼·马里亚·费迪南多·欧金尼奥·迪·萨伏依，生于1844年3月14日，卒于1900年7月29日。他自1878年1月9日起担任意大利国王，直至1900年遇刺身亡。在位期间，意大利殖民帝国形成，并与德国、奥匈帝国建立三国同盟。

en.s: The Battle of San Cristóbal (Spanish: Batalla de San Cristóbal) was a battle of the Thousand Days' War. Colombian troops besieged San Cristóbal (Venezuela) and took the city between 28 and 29 July 1901.

en.s: The Slocum massacre was a mass killing of black residents by whites on July 29–30, 1910, in Slocum, an unincorporated community in Anderson County near Palestine in East Texas. The death toll reported by major newspapers ranged between eight and 22, but evidence suggests as many as 200 African Americans were killed. Historians have offered several explanations for the sparking of the riot and massacre by whites.

Carried out by the Austro-Hungarian Danube Flotilla and supporting artillery across the Sava River, it was the first act of hostilities following the declaration of war on Serbia earlier that day.

en.s: The Cape Cod Canal is an artificial waterway in Massachusetts connecting Cape Cod Bay in the north to Buzzards Bay in the south, and is part of the Atlantic Intracoastal Waterway. The approximately 7.4-mile-long (11.9 km) canal traverses the neck of land joining Cape Cod to the state's mainland.

en.t: Great Depression: In Washington, D.C., troops disperse the last of the "Bonus Army" of World War I veterans using arson, bayonets, sabers, tanks, tear gas, and vomit gas
en.s: The Great Depression was a severe global economic downturn from 1929 to 1939. The period was marked by high rates of unemployment and poverty, drastic reductions in industrial production and international trade, and widespread bank and business failures around the world. The economic contagion began in 1929 in the United States, the largest economy in the world, with the devastating Wall Street crash of 1929 often considered the beginning of the Depression.

zh.t: 经济大萧条期间，华盛顿特区军队以纵火、刺刀、军刀、坦克、催泪瓦斯和催吐性毒气驱散最后一批一战“奖金军”退伍军人
zh.s: 经济大萧条是1929年至1939年间一场严重的全球经济衰退。其间失业和贫困率高企，工业生产和国际贸易大幅下滑，世界各地的银行和企业纷纷倒闭。经济危机于1929年从当时全球最大的经济体美国开始，灾难性的1929年华尔街股灾通常被视为大萧条的开端。

en.s: The Tongzhou mutiny (Chinese and Japanese: 通州事件; pinyin: Tōngzhōu Shìjiàn; Wade–Giles: Tungchow Shihchien; rōmaji: Tsūshū jiken), sometimes referred to as the Tongzhou Massacre, was an assault on Japanese civilians and troops by the security forces of East Hebei Autonomous Government in Tongzhou, China, on 29 July 1937, shortly after the Marco Polo Bridge incident, which triggered the outbreak of Second Sino-Japanese War.

zh.s: 通州事件（中文和日文：通州事件；拼音：Tōngzhōu Shìjiàn；威妥玛拼音：Tungchow Shihchien；日语罗马字：Tsūshū jiken），有时也称通州大屠杀。1937年7月29日，冀东自治政府的治安部队在中国通州袭击日本平民和军队。事件发生在卢沟桥事变之后不久，并引发了第二次中日战争。

en.s: The Battle of Kokoda consisted of two engagements fought in late July – early August 1942. Forming part of the Kokoda Track campaign of the Second World War, the battle involved military forces from Australia, supported by the United States, fighting against Japanese troops from Major General Tomitaro Horii's South Seas Detachment who had landed around Buna and Gona in Papua mid-July 1942, with the intent of capturing Port Moresby to the south via the overland route.

en.t: The BBC Light Programme radio station is launched for mainstream light entertainment and music
en.s: The BBC Light Programme was a national radio station which broadcast chiefly mainstream light entertainment and light music from 1945 until 1967, when it was replaced by BBC Radio 1 and BBC Radio 2. It opened on 29 July 1945, taking over the long wave frequency which had earlier been used – prior to the outbreak of the Second World War on 1 September 1939 – by the BBC National Programme.

It was the first military operation conducted by the Indonesian Air Force.

zh.t: 三宝垄—萨拉蒂加—安巴拉瓦空袭
zh.s: 印度尼西亚空军于1947年7月29日凌晨发动空袭，目标是印度尼西亚民族革命期间荷兰军队位于中爪哇安巴拉瓦镇、三宝垄市和萨拉蒂加市的军事目标。这是印度尼西亚空军执行的首场军事行动。

en.s: The modern Olympic Games (Olympics; French: Jeux olympiques) are a series of international multi-sport events. Considered among the biggest sporting events in the world, the Olympics are organised into distinct Summer and Winter Games, each featuring different sports. The Olympic Games, open to both amateur and professional athletes, involve thousands of athletes and more than 200 teams, each team representing a sovereign state or territory.
en.n: Olympic Games: The Games of the XIV Olympiad: After a hiatus of 12 years caused by World War II, the first Summer Olympics to be held since the 1936 Summer Olympics in Berlin, open in London.

en.s: The 1948 Summer Olympics, officially the Games of the XIV Olympiad and officially branded as London 1948, were an international multi-sport event held from 29 July to 14 August 1948 in London, United Kingdom. Following a twelve-year hiatus caused by the outbreak of World War II, these were the first Summer Olympics held since the 1936 Games in Berlin.

en.t: The International Atomic Energy Agency is established
en.s: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is an intergovernmental organization that seeks to promote the peaceful use of nuclear energy and to inhibit its use for any military purpose, including nuclear weapons. It was established in 1957 as an autonomous organization within the United Nations System; though governed by its own founding treaty, the organization reports to both the General Assembly and the Security Council of the United Nations, and is headquartered at the UN Office at Vienna, Austria.

en.s: The National Aeronautics and Space Act of 1958 (Pub. L. 85–568) is the United States federal statute that created the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). en.s: On July 29 1967, a fire broke out on board the aircraft carrier USS Forrestal, which was engaged in combat in the Gulf of Tonkin during the Vietnam War. The fire was caused by an inadvertently fired Zuni rocket which ruptured an external fuel tank of an A-4 Skyhawk. The tank's jet fuel spilled across the flight deck, ignited, and triggered a chain reaction of explosions that killed 134 sailors and injured 161.

zh.t: 1967年福莱斯特号航空母舰火灾
zh.s: 1967年7月29日，越南战争期间，正在北部湾执行战斗任务的福莱斯特号航空母舰上发生火灾。一枚意外发射的祖尼火箭击穿A-4“天鹰”攻击机的外部油箱，引发火灾。航空燃油洒在飞行甲板上并起火，随后连续发生爆炸，造成134名水兵死亡、161人受伤。

It lasted 35 seconds and heavily affected areas such as Altamira, Los Palos Grandes, and Litoral Central, and it was recorded at 6.6 on the moment magnitude scale. In the aftermath of the earthquake, there were several aftershocks of lower intensity.

en.s: The 1973 Dutch Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held at Zandvoort on July 29, 1973. It was the tenth race of the 1973 World Championship of Drivers and the 1973 International Cup for F1 Manufacturers. Zandvoort returned to the Formula One calendar following a year's absence for extensive safety upgrades to the race track including new asphalt, new barriers and a new race control tower. Jackie Stewart won the race, this Grand Prix being fourth of five wins for Stewart during the 1973 Formula One season, and he became the most successful Formula One driver of all time with his 26th Grand Prix victory, surpassing Jim Clark's record of 25 victories.

zh.s: 1973年荷兰大奖赛是一场一级方程式赛车比赛，于1973年7月29日在赞德沃特举行。这是1973年世界车手锦标赛和国际一级方程式制造商杯的第十站。赞德沃特赛道在缺席一年并完成大规模安全改造后重返一级方程式赛历，改造包括铺设新路面、安装新护栏和建造新的赛事控制塔。杰基·斯图尔特赢得比赛，这是他在1973赛季五场胜利中的第四场。他以第26个大奖赛冠军成为当时获胜次数最多的一级方程式车手，超过吉姆·克拉克保持的25胜纪录。

en.s: STS-51-F (also known as Spacelab 2) was the 19th flight of NASA's Space Shuttle program and the eighth flight of Space Shuttle Challenger. It launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on July 29, 1985, and landed eight days later on August 6, 1985. While STS-51-F's primary payload was the Spacelab 2 laboratory module, the payload that received the most publicity was the Carbonated Beverage Dispenser Evaluation, which was an experiment in which both Coca-Cola and Pepsi tried to make their carbonated drinks available to astronauts.

zh.s: STS-51-F（又称“太空实验室2”）是美国国家航空航天局航天飞机计划的第19次飞行，也是“挑战者”号航天飞机的第八次飞行。航天飞机于1985年7月29日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射升空，8天后于8月6日着陆。任务的主要载荷是“太空实验室2”实验舱，但最受媒体关注的是碳酸饮料分配器评估实验。该实验让可口可乐和百事公司尝试为宇航员提供各自的碳酸饮料。

en.s: A by-election was held in the British House of Commons constituency of Christchurch on 29 July 1993 following the death of sitting Conservative MP Robert Adley. The result was a gain for the Liberal Democrats, notable for the swing necessary to take such a strong Conservative seat, gaining more than 60% of the votes cast and winning practically twice as many votes as the Conservatives. As of May 2012, the swing of 35.4% remains the fifth largest by-election swing in British political history (the Bermondsey by-election in 1983 being the largest).

en.s: Operation Summer '95 (Bosnian, Croatian: Operacija Ljeto '95) was a joint military offensive of the Croatian Army (HV) and the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) that took place north-west of the Livanjsko field, and around Bosansko Grahovo and Glamoč in western Bosnia and Herzegovina. The operation was carried out between 25 and 29 July 1995, during the Croatian War of Independence and the Bosnian War. The attacking force of 8,500 troops commanded by HV's Lieutenant General Ante Gotovina initially encountered strong resistance from the 5,500-strong Army of Republika Srpska (VRS) 2nd Krajina Corps.

zh.s: “夏季行动95”（波斯尼亚语、克罗地亚语：Operacija Ljeto ’95）是克罗地亚军队（HV）与克罗地亚国防委员会（HVO）联合发动的一次攻势，战场位于波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那西部的利夫诺平原西北部，以及波桑斯科格拉霍沃和格拉莫奇周边。行动于1995年7月25日至29日进行，处于克罗地亚独立战争和波斯尼亚战争期间。安特·戈托维纳中将指挥的8,500名克罗地亚军队士兵起初遭到塞族共和国军（VRS）第二克拉伊纳军团的顽强抵抗，该军团有5,500人。

en.s: The island nation of São Tomé and Príncipe held presidential elections on 29 July 2001. It was the nation's third presidential election since the introduction of multi-party politics in 1990. Incumbent Miguel Trovoada was constitutionally barred from participating in the election having served the maximum of two five year terms. The two top contenders for the position were Fradique de Menezes, a wealthy businessman, and Manuel Pinto da Costa, former President and founder of the former single-party, the MLSTP-PSD. The election, deemed free and fair by international observers, was won in the first round by Menezes.

zh.t: 2001年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于2001年7月29日举行总统选举。这是该国自1990年实行多党制以来的第三次总统选举。现任总统米格尔·特罗瓦达已连任两届五年任期，受宪法限制不能参选。两名主要候选人是富商弗拉迪克·德梅内塞斯，以及前总统、前一党制执政党圣多美和普林西比解放运动/社会民主党（MLSTP-PSD）创始人曼努埃尔·平托·达科斯塔。国际观察员认为选举自由、公正；德梅内塞斯在首轮投票中获胜。

The Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and its election allies, were the major winner, provided Koizumi a strong mandates to move forward with his reform policies.

en.s: General elections for the Central Tibetan Administration (the Tibetan government in exile) were held on 29 July 2001. For the first time, voters elected the Kalön Tripa (Prime Minister), as well as members of Parliament. Previously the Prime Minister had been appointed by the Dalai Lama under the Parliament's ratification. This was part of a series of reforms encouraged by the Dalai Lama for the democratization of the exile Tibetan community.

en.t: Early insurgency phase of the Syrian civil war
en.s: The early insurgency phase of the Syrian civil war lasted from late July 2011 to April 2012, and was associated with the rise of armed opposition militias across Syria and the beginning of armed revolution against the Syrian Ba'athist regime ruled by president Bashar al-Assad. Though armed insurrection incidents began as early as June 2011 when rebels killed 120–140 Syrian security personnel, the beginning of organized insurgency is typically marked by the formation of the Free Syrian Army (FSA) on 29 July 2011, when a group of defected officers declared the establishment of the first organized opposition armed group.

en.s: Operation Sarbakaf is an ongoing Pakistan Army-led counterterrorism offensive launched on 29 July 2025 in Bajaur District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Security forces began the operation in Loi (Lowi), Mamund Tehsil around 9:00 AM, supported by gunship helicopters and artillery, and simultaneously imposed a three-day curfew in 16 villages. Federal authorities and provincial authorities described the aim as eliminating militant hideouts and restoring security in the troubled border region, where a resurgence of Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) activity had been reported.
